evidence_quote: Therefore, the area of one room is 160 / 6 = 26.67 square feet.
question_evidence_quote: There are 6 rooms in total.  All the rooms are the same size except the living room which is as big as 3 other rooms.
observed_error: The response divides the apartment area equally among six rooms to obtain the ordinary room area.
violated_condition: The six rooms comprise five ordinary rooms and one living room of triple area, so total area is 5x + 3x = 8x.
error_description: The response uses 160 / 6 to calculate an ordinary room's area, treating the six rooms as equal shares. The living room occupies three ordinary-room shares, so five ordinary rooms plus the living room account for eight shares. The division uses the wrong relation; its arithmetic is correctly rounded.
